title: Detailed snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Base of snow globe -->
  <rect x="25" y="72" width="50" height="8" rx="3" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <rect x="25" y="72" width="50" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <rect x="22" y="78" width="56" height="10" rx="4" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <rect x="22" y="78" width="56" height="4" rx="2" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- Gold trim on base -->
  <rect x="24" y="76" width="52" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="24" y="76" width="52" height="1.5" rx="0.75" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  
  <!-- Globe glass sphere -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="32" fill="#1E3A5F" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="32" fill="none" stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Snow ground inside globe -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#E8F0FF"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="67" rx="26" ry="6" fill="#F5FAFF"/>
  
  <!-- Snowman -->
  <!-- Bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="8" fill="#F0F6FF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#D0E0F0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Middle snowball -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="51" r="6" fill="#F0F6FF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="51" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#D0E0F0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="4.5" fill="#F5FAFF"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="4.5" fill="none" stroke="#D0E0F0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="48.5" cy="41" r="0.8" fill="#2C2C3A"/>
  <circle cx="51.5" cy="41" r="0.8" fill="#2C2C3A"/>
  <!-- Carrot nose -->
  <polygon points="50,42.5 53,43.5 50,44.5" fill="#FF8C00"/>
  <!-- Buttons -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="49.5" r="0.7" fill="#2C2C3A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="0.7" fill="#2C2C3A"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="54.5" r="0.7" fill="#2C2C3A"/>
  <!-- Scarf -->
  <rect x="45" y="46.5" width="10" height="2" rx="1" fill="#E84040"/>
  <rect x="53" y="47.5" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E84040"/>
  <!-- Hat -->
  <rect x="45.5" y="37" width="9" height="3" rx="1" fill="#2C2C3A"/>
  <rect x="47" y="32" width="6" height="6" rx="1" fill="#2C2C3A"/>
  <rect x="47" y="32" width="6" height="2" rx="1" fill="#E84040"/>
  <!-- Arm -->
  <line x1="42" y1="51" x2="36" y2="46" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="51" x2="64" y2="47" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Pine trees -->
  <polygon points="30,66 26,58 34,58" fill="#1B6B3A"/>
  <polygon points="30,62 26,54 34,54" fill="#238C4A"/>
  <polygon points="30,58 27,52 33,52" fill="#2AA555"/>
  <rect x="29" y="66" width="2" height="3" fill="#8B4513"/>
  
  <polygon points="70,66 66,57 74,57" fill="#1B6B3A"/>
  <polygon points="70,61 66,53 74,53" fill="#238C4A"/>
  <polygon points="70,57 67,50 73,50" fill="#2AA555"/>
  <rect x="69" y="66" width="2" height="3" fill="#8B4513"/>
  
  <!-- Small tree -->
  <polygon points="38,66 36,61 40,61" fill="#238C4A"/>
  <polygon points="38,63 36,58 40,58" fill="#2AA555"/>
  <rect x="37.5" y="66" width="1" height="2" fill="#8B4513"/>
  
  <!-- Snowflakes falling -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="30" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="25" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="22" r="0.7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="35" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="42" r="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="28" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="18" r="0.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="45" r="0.7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="50" r="0.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="20" r="0.7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="35" r="0.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="38" r="0.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="35" r="0.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Glass shine highlights -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="30" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08" transform="rotate(-20 38 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="28" rx="4" ry="8" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.06" transform="rotate(15 62 28)"/>
  
  <!-- Star on top of globe -->
  <polygon points="50,10 51.5,14 56,14 52.5,16.5 54,21 50,18.5 46,21 47.5,16.5 44,14 48.5,14" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <polygon points="50,10 51.5,14 56,14 52.5,16.5 54,21 50,18.5 46,21 47.5,16.5 44,14 48.5,14" fill="none" stroke="#FFE44D" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Moon inside globe -->
  <circle cx="64" cy="24" r="4" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="23" r="3.5" fill="#1E3A5F" opacity="0.9"/>
</svg>
